answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register through a wharf auction where entry requires cryptographic stake burning. Identities link into a reputation trellis where validation rights scale with burnt collateral. Verification algorithms, codenamed falcon, enforce superlinear cost scaling: registering $k$ identities incurs an exponential cost of $O(c^k)$ burned tokens, making mass identity spoofing mathematically and economically unfeasible.
